name: Extended Particle System with Gradient-Weighted Projection
definition: A surface extraction method using a particle system where repulsive and attractive forces are decoupled in time, using gradient-weighted projection to settle particles on the isosurface and Voronoi diagrams for incremental insertion.
summary: Extended Particle System with Gradient-Weighted Projection is a surface extraction method that decouples attraction and repulsion forces, using gradient-weighted projection to settle particles on the isosurface.
